name: library-agent

dependencies.name: library-api
dependencies.description: Fetch available books for mood-based suggestions, and the caller's own loans for plain-language loan questions.

description: A single conversational agent: for a member, given a free-text mood description it suggests two or three available books with one-line reasons, or given a plain-language question about the caller's own loans it answers from that caller's real loan records; for a librarian, given an uploaded photo of a book it extracts the book's details and adds it to the catalog once the librarian confirms. Does not edit or remove books, and does not create or modify loans.
